[Unit]
Description=Live page of the bot (read-only WebSocket)
After=network-online.target acct-api-regr.service

[Service]
User=tbot
Environment=POS_DIR=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr
Environment=LIVE_PORT=18110
Environment=LIVE_CTL_PORT=18111
Environment=ACCT_PORT=18102
ExecStart=/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /opt/trading-bot/live/live_web.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
Nice=10
CPUQuota=25%
MemoryMax=200M
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/trading-bot/live

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
